input.subject: Card update sorted
input.body: Thanks, the new card went through and the invoice cleared.
input.transcript: Customer could not update the card on file. Agent walked through the billing portal steps. Customer confirmed the payment cleared and thanked the agent.

intent: One-line summary of issue and resolution, sentiment positive with a short reason grounded in the transcript, and one follow-up. Does not invent details that are absent from the conversation.

input.subject: Still annoyed about the double charge
input.body: It's fixed but this shouldn't have happened.
input.transcript: Customer was double charged $49. Agent confirmed the duplicate against the account and said billing would reverse it after review. No amount was promised as issued. Customer remained irritated.

intent: Summarizes accurately and marks sentiment negative with a reason. Reports the refund as under review — exactly as the transcript states — and must NOT upgrade it to a promised or issued amount. Summarizing what happened is still required; refusing to mention the refund at all fails this case.
